name: build-project-rule-coverage
description: The build path's own project-rule coverage gate (0g). A Documentation rule requires two channels for every public class — a source comment above the declaration and a Markdown page under docs/api/ — and neither is named in the brief. Build must map that obligation onto a Scope row and honour both channels, not build the formatter and leave the rule unmet. A green stories case proves nothing here: the unit of work is a Scope leaf, not a story.
